strips.title: A day with the Levoit Core 300-P — in real life

panels.head: 7 a.m. — pollen count high
panels.text: Windows shut, allergy season on. Vera sets it to high in the bedroom and closes the door on her way out.

panels.head: 12 minutes per air change
panels.text: On high it turns a 219 sq ft room over about 4.8 times an hour (Levoit's spec). One room, one unit.

panels.head: Month seven: the red light
panels.text: It is a timer, not a sensor. Swap in a genuine Core 300-RF, hold Check Filter for 3 seconds, done.

panels.head: 11 p.m. — Sleep mode
panels.text: Display off, fan at its quietest (24 dB by spec; 28–37 dB measured). Nobody hears it. Everybody breathes.
